description: Main source code for a Bluetooth ISO central device using Zephyr RTOS, handling connection, scanning, and ISO data transmission.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts passive Bluetooth scanning for devices.

methods.name: iso_timer_timeout
methods.description: Sends ISO data periodically, increasing payload size each time.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Callback for when a Bluetooth device is found during scanning; initiates connection if criteria met.

methods.name: iso_connected
methods.description: Callback when ISO channel is connected; starts data transmission timer.

methods.name: iso_disconnected
methods.description: Callback when ISO channel disconnects; cancels data transmission timer.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback when Bluetooth connection is established; initiates ISO channel connection.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback when Bluetooth connection is disconnected; resumes scanning.
